# ONTO

> ONTO examines any AI model for invented answers and trains open models to answer from a source (the canon GOLD or the client's own library). Qwen 7B before and after ONTO: answers from the source 0 to 90 per 100 questions never seen in training; invented answers on outside questions 19.2 to 7.7 per 100. Every result is a numbered, dated document.

- [Products](https://ontostandard.org/products/): exam (any model, through its API), diploma (levels I to III), training on a source, sandbox
- [For researchers](https://ontostandard.org/for/researchers/) · [For governments](https://ontostandard.org/for/governments/) · [For companies](https://ontostandard.org/for/companies/)
- [Method](https://ontostandard.org/method/): what is measured and how results are accepted (ONTO:2610.0007)
- [Lab](https://ontostandard.org/lab/): news (what was done and what it led to, newest first, each result with its document), work in progress, students
- [Demo](https://ontostandard.org/demo/): recorded answers of a regular model and the ONTO student
- [Archive](https://ontostandard.org/archive/): numbered, dated documents; corrections come as new versions
- [Archive catalogue](https://ontostandard.org/archive/archive.json) · [Live numbers](https://ontostandard.org/status.json) · [News feed](https://ontostandard.org/news.json)

Closed by design: the canon (GOLD), training data and recipe, trained weights, judges' code, held-out question sets.
Contact: council@ontostandard.org
